GO

GO

CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMER_SEC] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
(   --SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CLTCODE ORDER BY DATE_OPEN) RN, * FROM (
    --SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    --JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1
    --JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 
    --) A
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, MIN(BSA.DATE_OPEN) DATE_OPEN 
    FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSL.CLTCODE = BSC.CLTCODE AND BSL.isLatest = 1 AND BSL.isActive = 1
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA ON BSA.ACCTKEY = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.isLatest = 1 AND BSA.isActive = 1
    WHERE  BSC.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSC.isActive = 1 
    group by BSC.CLTCODE
)
, TMP_BNKM_Customer AS 
(
SELECT DISTINCT
     CONVERT(VARCHAR, BSC.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL OR BSC.LASTUPDATED = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' 
          THEN CASE WHEN  GDC.DATE_OPEN IS NULL OR BSC.LASTUPDATED = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000'  THEN  '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000'
                    ELSE GDC.DATE_OPEN END
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS CustomerEstablishedDate
    ,BSC.CLTTYPE AS CustomerTypeId
    ,SGC.GLOBAL_CIF AS PartyId
    ,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE --AND RN  = 1
LEFT JOIN SYN.GLOBAL_CIF_TABLE SGC ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, LEN(RIGHT(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR,CHARINDEX('_', REVERSE(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR))+7)), 4) ) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BSC.CLTCODE)
WHERE BSC.ISLATEST = 1
)
SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_Customer FROM TMP_BNKM_Customer;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_Customer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
,CONVERT(DATE,CustomerEstablishedDate)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerTypeId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TMP_BNKM_Customer 
)
,
TMP_BNKM_Customer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
,CONVERT(DATE,CustomerEstablishedDate)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerTypeId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.Customer WHERE SOURCECODE = 'SEC'	
)
,
TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_Customer_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TMP_BNKM_Customer_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
    CustomerEstablishedDate = SRC.CustomerEstablishedDate
    ,CustomerTypeId = SRC.CustomerTypeId
    ,PartyId = SRC.PartyId
    ,ResponsibilityCenterId = NULL
    ,LedgerId = NULL
    ,LedgerAccountNumber = NULL
    ,CustomerNote = NULL
    ,GlobalLocationNumber = NULL
    ,BranchId = NULL
    ,CustomerCreationModeId = NULL
    ,EntityCreationIndicator = NULL
    ,SuspendedIndicator = NULL
    ,CoreCustomerId = NULL
FROM BNKM.Customer TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
 AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_Customer SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.SOURCECODE = 'SEC';
 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.Customer
(
     CustomerId
    ,CustomerEstablishedDate
    ,CustomerTypeId
    ,PartyId
    ,ResponsibilityCenterId
    ,LedgerId
    ,LedgerAccountNumber
    ,CustomerNote
    ,GlobalLocationNumber
    ,BranchId
    ,CustomerCreationModeId
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,EntityCreationIndicator
    ,SuspendedIndicator
    ,CoreCustomerId
    ,SourceSystemCode
	,SourceCode
	,WorkFlowId 
	,TaskRunId 
	,InsertDttm 
)
SELECT
    SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,SRC.CustomerEstablishedDate AS CustomerEstablishedDate
    ,SRC.CustomerTypeId AS CustomerTypeId
    ,SRC.PartyId AS PartyId
    ,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
    ,NULL AS LedgerId
    ,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
    ,NULL AS CustomerNote
    ,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
    ,NULL AS BranchId
    ,NULL AS CustomerCreationModeId
    ,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,NULL AS EntityCreationIndicator
    ,NULL AS SuspendedIndicator
    ,NULL AS CoreCustomerId
    ,SRC.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
    ,SRC.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId 
    ,0 AS TaskRunId 
    ,SRC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_Customer SRC
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA DELTA	 
ON  DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_Customer;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA;

END
GO
